name: read_pdf
description: Read a PDF (a local path or an http(s) URL) and return its text. A PDF with a text layer is extracted directly. A scanned or image-only PDF has its pages rendered to images and read with a vision model — the session model when it can see images, otherwise a local vision model is picked automatically (the session model is unloaded to make room and reloads on the next round). Use this instead of read_file or a shell command for .pdf files, and never tell the user PDFs cannot be read. 'pages' limits which pages are read.

url.description: absolute http(s) PDF URL (give this instead of path)

pages.description: which pages, e.g. "1-3,7" or "all" (optional; defaults to the first pages)

mode.description: auto (default) uses the text layer when the PDF has one and vision for scans; text never calls a model; vision always reads page images (use it for figures or tables in a text PDF)
